Her everyday account holds $1,000 today (the $650 she started with plus this month's money so far), so it will be about $350 at the end of November. Her safety net holds $2,000, its full size, locked (the default); no overdraft is recorded. She looks at a $9,000 car over 48 months at 7.9%, bought today, first payment on 15 December 2026. Cash path (90 days, to 12 February 2027): $1,000 today, about $350 at the end of November once the $650 still to come is spent; every later month is $300 short, or $519.30 short with the $219.30 payment, and two payments fall in the window (15 December, 15 January). Without the car she still goes below $0, from 26 January, lowest $250 below on 31 January: the car brings it a month earlier and $438.60 deeper.
